scientific_choices.choice: Section3.5 prose and Algorithm2: MPNet semantic T1/T3 winner, selected candidate C=.6S+.4 raw fuzzy ratio, tau=.8, DeepSolo full-image fallback. Table5 TotalText78.4/79.8 recognition accuracy is preserved but not assumed equivalent to our metric.

Reuse qualified TextOCR YOLOv8s640 and genuine PARSeq checkpoint; use the existing joint0.60 plus same-reading NMS0.5 family; reuse all300 frozen TEST direct-box OCR outputs, audited image-only BLIP2 captions, full-image PARSeq T1 and all425 qualified DeepSolo metrics.

Replace localization with YOLO, retain all final detector/OCR outputs for image-level routing (including evaluation-ignored words), never per-word routing, rescue or GT filtering. T3 joins every selected reading by top/left/ID. Accept T1 as one raw sequence only when its own selected confidence passes. This is an external detector experiment, not strict paper reproduction.

Keep our previously fixed B16 native_word_advantage family; refit only empirical mid-CDF references on TRAIN80 YOLO words. Gate is the minimum sqrt(native-rank times word-versus-background-rank) over every word. Freeze six GT-blind coverage cuts on TRAIN80 before any new TEST CLIP/MPNet features. Native-only and joint-only controls use the same cuts protocol. No family/threshold selection from TEST correctness.

Primary local evaluation matches whole words casefold-exact with punctuation retained and no spatial IoU, one-to-one per image, identical for YOLO/T1/DeepSolo. Retain all2204 TEST care GT, invalid outputs and empty-image FN. Native256 entirely-invalid support controls ignore consistently with prior routing experiments; this differs from official polygon-overlap ignore and from the separate YOLO don't-care report. A spatial YOLO diagnostic is separate.

Compare YOLO-only, DeepSolo-only, both routers at unchanged TRAIN cuts, same image budgets, original paper tau.8, exact GT-only microF1/TN0 oracle and conditional paired image bootstrap. Equal-budget TEST ranks are descriptive, not scalar deployment cuts; oracle never enters inference. YOLO joint family was explored on TEST previously, so results are exploratory, not an untouched validation.

RTX3090 rather than target3070; existing isolated YOLO environment; sequential CUDA FP32 YOLO batch1 and CLIP batch16, CPU FP32 PARSeq batch32 matching cached TEST and CPU MPNet. Deterministic algorithms on and TF32 off; no silent device fallback. Models are unloaded sequentially, record actual detector tensor shapes and GPU allocator peaks, propagate OOM. Cached captions retain original FP16/offload receipts; no new caption or DeepSolo inference.

Authors' no-routing U-Net accuracy, exact component checkpoints, multiple-crop semantics and recognition-accuracy protocol remain unknown. A controlled YOLO comparison can establish local router benefit but cannot establish beating Table5 on its undefined metric. TRAIN125 holdout is not the entire training split and DeepSolo was fine-tuned on TotalTextTRAIN.
